# docker_volumes (Data Source)

Lists the volumes on the provider's Docker host (`GET /volumes`), like `docker volume ls`. The optional arguments are Engine API filters; `volumes.volumes` is sorted by name. The raw `volumes_json` output is sensitive because driver options can hold credentials.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Volumes no container uses.
data "docker_volumes" "unused" {
  dangling = true
}

output "unused_volume_names" {
  value = data.docker_volumes.unused.names
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `dangling` (Boolean) `true` lists only volumes no container uses, `false` only used ones.
- `driver` (String) Only volumes using this driver, e.g. `local`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Only volumes carrying every one of these labels (Engine `label` filter); an empty value matches any value.
- `name` (String) Only volumes whose name matches (Engine `name` filter, a substring match).

### Read-Only

- `content_sha256` (String) sha256 of volumes_json.
- `docker_server_version` (String) Docker Engine version from GET /version.
- `engine_api_version` (String) Engine API version negotiated with the daemon (min of the client maximum and GET /version ApiVersion).
- `names` (List of String) Names of the listed volumes, sorted.
- `volumes` (Attributes) The GET /volumes response as a nested object, field by field. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes))
- `volumes_json` (String, Sensitive) The Engine API GET /volumes response as JSON; Volumes sorted by name. Re-encoded, not byte-exact: the moby client keeps no raw body for this call, so this is the decoded response written as canonical JSON (keys sorted, compact).

<a id="nestedatt--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes`

Read-Only:

- `volumes` (Attributes List) Upstream `Volumes`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--volumes--volumes))
- `warnings` (List of String) Upstream `Warnings`.

<a id="nestedatt--volumes--volumes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `volumes.volumes`

Read-Only:

- `cluster_volume` (String) Upstream `ClusterVolume`. Canonical JSON (keys sorted, snake_case): no nested fields are fixed here and Terraform allows no dynamic value inside a list, set or map.
- `created_at` (String) Upstream `CreatedAt`.
- `driver` (String) Upstream `Driver`.
- `labels` (Map of String) Upstream `Labels`.
- `mountpoint` (String) Upstream `Mountpoint`.
- `name` (String) Upstream `Name`.
- `options` (Map of String, Sensitive) Upstream `Options`. Sensitive.
- `scope` (String) Upstream `Scope`.
- `status` (String) Upstream `Status`. Canonical JSON (keys sorted, snake_case): no nested fields are fixed here and Terraform allows no dynamic value inside a list, set or map.
- `usage_data` (String) Upstream `UsageData`. Canonical JSON (keys sorted, snake_case): no nested fields are fixed here and Terraform allows no dynamic value inside a list, set or map.
